paragraphs.source_en: Every person’s life is filled with countless wondrous differences. People call their own experience “life.” At each of its different stages, life has an entirely different substance, just as every human face is different.

units.source_en: Every person’s life is filled with countless wondrous differences.
units.source_zh: 不同的人，一生充满无数奇妙的差异。

units.source_en: People call their own experience “life.”
units.source_zh: 人们把自己的经验称作“人生”。

units.source_en: At each of its different stages, life has an entirely different substance, just as every human face is different.
units.source_zh: 人生在各个不同的时期，有着完全不同的内容，即如人的面孔。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不同的人，一生充满无数奇妙的差异。人们把自己的经验称作“人生”。人生在各个不同的时期，有着完全不同的内容，即如人的面孔。

paragraphs.source_en: Within Osaka Castle, word gradually spread that Toyotomi Hideyori was ill; everyone was deeply alarmed and indulged in all manner of speculation.

units.source_en: Within Osaka Castle, word gradually spread that Toyotomi Hideyori was ill; everyone was deeply alarmed and indulged in all manner of speculation.

paragraphs.source_zh: 大坂城内，丰臣秀赖有恙的消息逐渐传开，人人都甚感吃惊，作了各种各样的猜测。

paragraphs.source_en: “What illness has he contracted?”

units.source_en: “What illness has he contracted?”
units.source_zh: “生的是何病？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “生的是何病？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Smallpox.”

units.source_en: “Smallpox.”
units.source_zh: “天花。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “天花。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Smallpox? Surely his life is not in danger?”

units.source_en: “Smallpox? Surely his life is not in danger?”

paragraphs.source_zh: “天花啊，不会有性命之忧吧？”

paragraphs.source_en: Neither those who asked nor those who answered were so heartless as to wish Hideyori harm. Yet everyone knew that once a person caught smallpox, eight or nine times out of ten it meant death; even survivors were left beyond recognition. The pages and maids feared that scars would remain on Hideyori’s face after his recovery, while their elders feared for his life.

units.source_en: Neither those who asked nor those who answered were so heartless as to wish Hideyori harm.

paragraphs.source_en: The many conjectures bred many anxieties, which spread even among the common people, until the whole castle lay beneath a pall of panic. Though outwardly everyone appeared unchanged, in private they acted quite differently.

units.source_en: The many conjectures bred many anxieties, which spread even among the common people, until the whole castle lay beneath a pall of panic.

paragraphs.source_en: First came Fukushima Masanori, who turned back midway through his journey to Edo to pay a visit. He did not enter the sickroom, but merely met Lady Yodo, and the two wept before each other; By chance, the Kyushu daimyo Takahashi Mototane had also come to inquire after Hideyori; together the two went to the residence of Oda Jōshin within the castle, spoke privately for several hours, and then departed.

paragraphs.source_en: Then news arrived from Fushimi Castle that Ōkubo Tadachika would come to pay his respects.

units.source_en: Then news arrived from Fushimi Castle that Ōkubo Tadachika would come to pay his respects.

paragraphs.source_en: It was precisely Ōkubo Tadachika’s impending arrival that threw Osaka Castle’s senior retainers into confusion. Mindful that the illness might be contagious, Katagiri Katsumoto had largely barred the senior retainers from approaching Hideyori, and physicians admitted to the inner castle were not permitted to leave again. Yet now, of all times, Ōkubo Tadachika—a Tokugawa elder equal in standing to Honda Masanobu—was coming. His purpose seemed less to inquire after the patient than to investigate the situation. Even if the Toyotomi men suspected as much, however, they could never let it show.
